meta.name: dnanexus-integration
meta.description: Build and operate reproducible genomics workloads on DNAnexus with the dx CLI, dxpy, apps/applets, native workflows, dxCompiler, and Nextflow. Use for DNAnexus data transfers, dxapp.json development, execution monitoring, workflow import, and project automation.

copy.tagline: 让基因组分析在云端标准化自动运行
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常批量跑测序分析,希望过程可复现且云端自动调度
copy.tagline_en: Automate reproducible genomics analyses in the cloud.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage many genomics analyses and need automated reproducible runs.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能帮你在 DNAnexus 云平台上做基因组分析:上传下载数据、构建部署 app/applet、启动作业并查看日志,以及用 dxpy 写自动化脚本。
howto.when: 当你要求构建或修改 DNAnexus app/applet、上传下载或查找平台数据、运行并监控分析任务,或配置 dxapp.json 依赖时触发。

say.text: 列出项目里所有 *.bam 文件并下载到本地
say.note: 先搜索匹配对象,再逐个下载

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can help you work on DNAnexus: upload and download genomics data, build and deploy apps/applets, launch and monitor jobs, and write dxpy automation scripts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to build or modify a DNAnexus app/applet, upload, download or search platform data, run and monitor analyses, or configure dxapp.json dependencies.

say_en.text: Upload my local sample.fastq to project project-xxxx with dxpy
say_en.note: Uploads the file and returns its file ID

say_en.text: Write a dxapp.json with input reads, output aligned_bam, and a bwa dependency
say_en.note: Creates the config file for dx build

say_en.text: List all *.bam files in my project and download them
say_en.note: Searches first, then downloads each file
